claimBoundary: Passing semantic and synthetic-audio cases proves bounded contract behavior only, not vocal quality or preference.
Synthetic vocal-like fixtures are TrackSmith-authored deterministic signals, not speech, a singer, or evidence of intelligibility.
Objective metrics remain guardrails; naturalness, emotional result, intelligibility, transformation relevance, and preference require blinded listening.
Provider-offline success means local deterministic interpretation and planning remain available; it does not prove frontier semantic accuracy.
Rendered-asset checks prove local provenance, finite output, deterministic replay, exact outside-scope preservation, and source immutability—not perceptual superiority.
This map defines objective contract and execution risks. It does not convert passing fixtures into claims of vocal quality, intelligibility, naturalness, emotional success, or listener preference.
